say: Documents, data, messages and business requests supply the information for different employee tasks. say: Employees provide a business question and relevant material to an application supporting one of the seven tasks. The application combines language-model work with operational tools. The LLM interprets questions, compares sources and drafts content. Tools query systems, perform calculations, process files and run code or tests. Shared approved documents, knowledge bases and business data support both roles, with access controls, source references and version history. The application returns a concrete business output, such as a client-update draft, for staff to check and use. Qwen and DeepSeek are candidates for evaluation on the company's tasks.

say: Implementation proceeds through three business-led phases. The first focuses on research and client communications, with research, sales, compliance and IT contributing sample tasks, a source inventory and initial applications. The second integrates trading and operations, with trading, operations and IT defining data, system-query interfaces and document workflows. The third expands development support and internal services, with business teams and IT delivering tools, user guides and named maintenance ownership. Each phase has an identifiable business scope and a usable deliverable. The work can be planned and assessed against those business deliverables.

say: Evaluation begins with a baseline for research and client-communications tasks. Colleagues use the application and record the outcome. Completion time runs from starting the task to completing its output. Output use records whether teams actually use the analysis and materials. Rework records revision rounds and repeated checks. Repeat usage records whether employees continue to use the application. The team compares those results with the baseline, reviews where the workflow needs improvement and refines it before subsequent use. The baseline comparison establishes the effect on actual employee work.
